$comment: runtime/openvr: Valve's openvr_api.dll for the SteamVR caption overlay (P6-B), loaded lazily by services/vr_overlay through hand-written FFI (never load-time linked; SteamVR itself is never started by Sigil).

OpenVR SDK v2.15.6 (2026-03-27), commit 0924064316de3effbcd1acf1e309182a2deb1c05, bin/win64/openvr_api.dll. Size and git blob id from the GitHub contents API at that commit (a plain git file, not LFS).

The FFI's function-table indexes (vr_overlay/openvr.rs) come from headers/openvr_capi.h at the same commit (IVRSystem_026, IVROverlay_028). Upgrade: bump version, path pin and revision together, re-derive the indexes from that header, and re-run `cargo test vr_overlay` plus the manual SteamVR check.

entries.title: OpenVR runtime (SteamVR caption overlay)
entries.description: Lets Sigil show captions inside SteamVR. About 0.8 MB. SteamVR itself is not included and Sigil never starts it.
